headline: Earnings per share rebound from last quarter, lag last year
summary_short: EPS of $1.00 was up $0.47 from $0.53 last quarter but down $0.25 from $1.25 a year earlier.
summary_long: Earnings per share came in at $1.00. That is nearly double the prior quarter's $0.53 and 20% below the $1.25 reported for the same quarter last year. The current figure comes from Yahoo's earnings chart; prior periods are SEC-filed basic EPS.
